theorem positive_integer_is_gcd_of_40_iff_dvd
  (y : ℤ)
  (hy : 0 < y) :
  ((Int.gcd 40 y : ℤ) = y ↔ y ∣ 40) := by
  have hycast : (y.natAbs : ℤ) = y := by
    rw [Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hy)]
  change ((Nat.gcd 40 y.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) = y ↔ y ∣ (40 : ℤ)
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hEq : (Nat.gcd 40 y.natAbs : ℤ) = (y.natAbs : ℤ) :=
      h.trans hycast.symm
    have hn : Nat.gcd 40 y.natAbs = y.natAbs := by
      exact_mod_cast hEq
    have hdN : y.natAbs ∣ 40 :=
      (Nat.gcd_eq_right_iff_dvd).mp hn
    have hdZ : (y.natAbs : ℤ) ∣ (40 : ℤ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hdN
    simpa [hycast] using hdZ
  · intro h
    have hdZ : (y.natAbs : ℤ) ∣ (40 : ℤ) := by
      simpa [hycast] using h
    have hdN : y.natAbs ∣ 40 := by
      exact_mod_cast hdZ
    have hn : Nat.gcd 40 y.natAbs = y.natAbs :=
      (Nat.gcd_eq_right_iff_dvd).mpr hdN
    calc
      (Nat.gcd 40 y.natAbs : ℤ) = (y.natAbs : ℤ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hn
      _ = y := hycast
